Alex — thanks again for the kickoff. I drafted a compact "wiring playlist" so we can move from discovery to a short evaluation runway. Goal: have basic connectivity + scoped keys validated so your engineers can run the latency and quality checks the week of Dec 7.

High-level next steps (owner / due):
- Redwood: create demo org and seed RBAC invites (vanessa) / Nov 23
- Beacon: confirm 2 engineer accounts + security contact for invites / Nov 24
- Redwood: issue scoped API keys via secure DocuSign (marissa) / Nov 23
- Beacon IT: add Redwood allowlist ranges (see below) / Nov 24
- Redwood infra: open VPC peering request for test VPC (evelyn) / Nov 25

Minimal IP ranges for quick validation (please relay to your network team): 13.52.192.0/22, 20.191.64.0/22. We will provide full ASN and routing snippet when we open the peering ticket.

Acceptance criteria (for the pilot):
- API key auth + simple generation call succeeds from your infra
- Latency baseline report for 1k samples under 100ms p50 (approx)
- Static allowlist connectivity verified (no blocked ports)

Ask: can you reply with the two engineer emails and the security contact (name + email) so we can send invites today?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.ai

Hi Alex — quick technical snippet to paste into your ticket or firewall change request:
- Redwood test ASN: 64512 (announce-only for POC)
- Required CIDRs: 13.52.192.0/22, 20.191.64.0/22
- TCP ports: 443 and 80 for control plane checks; 443 only required for production API calls
- Peering request fields: customer VPC id, region, preferred peering window (we recommend 11/26–11/30 for provisioning), contact + maintenance window

Peering preflight checklist (short):
- Ensure route propagation enabled on your side
- Confirm inbound ACL allows 13.52.192.0/22 and 20.191.64.0/22
- Provide customer VPC CIDR and preferred ASN in ticket

If you want I can open the peering request from Redwood's side — I only need your VPC ID and a preferred maintenance window.

Evelyn Hart
